info.title: Setu API
info.description: Control-plane REST API for single-binary web apps

get.summary:
The next undelivered command for this server (200), or 204 when none
arrives within the wait window. Delivery marks the command delivered
and counts the attempt; agents are idempotent, so the control plane
may redeliver after `requeue_stale`. Polled per server at 600/min
(spec §7); past that the poll is 429.

204.description: No command within the wait window

post.summary:
Report a command result; unblocks the `DbAgentClient::call` waiting on
it. Scoped to the authed server: a command owned by another server is
404, so agents cannot complete each other's commands. Unknown ids are
404; a body id that disagrees with the path is a 400 (the path is
authoritative). Repeat posts are an ok idempotent no-op (first writer
wins, no overwrite — see `complete_for`).

Heartbeat: marks the server `online` and stores the metrics batch
(the repo upserts both atomically).

Redeem a single-use join token (`JoinRequest` → `JoinResponse`). A
spent, unknown or expired token is 401 from the repo; the join marks
the server `online`.

get.summary: List catalogue apps (viewer and above).

post.summary: Publish a version from pasted TOML or a URL (operator and above).

Validate pasted TOML without storing it (operator and above). Always
200: validity is in the body (`ok` + `errors`).

get.summary: One app's versions, newest first (viewer and above).

Recent audit rows, newest first (viewer and above — the authz matrix
grants viewers every GET).

post.summary:
Log in: verify the argon2id hash, rotate the session id (fixation
guard), store the operator id, and return the operator. Failures count
per source IP: 10 within 15 minutes → 429 on subsequent attempts.
Log out: destroy the session. Anonymous callers get 401 (checked first,

get.summary: The current operator, or 401 when anonymous.
Recent jobs, newest first (viewer and above).
One job (viewer and above).

Tail a job's log as SSE (viewer and above): the accumulated `jobs.log`
lines first, then — while the job is still `queued`/`running` — new
deltas every 500 ms until it finishes or 30 s pass. Finished jobs
close the stream after the backlog.
List operators (owner only).

post.summary:
Create an operator (owner only). The password is hashed with argon2id
before storage and never logged.

get.summary: List plans (viewer and above).

post.summary: Create a plan (owner only).

get.summary: One plan (viewer and above).
List servers (viewer and above).

post.summary: Register a pending server and mint its join token (operator and above).

get.summary: One server (viewer and above).

delete.summary: Delete a server (operator and above); 409 while sites reference it.

get.summary:
Setup status (public, no auth): whether the first owner still needs
creating, plus the public URL for the wizard to display.

post.summary:
Create the owner operator. Public, exactly once: while at least one
operator exists this is 409 `conflict` regardless of authentication.

Register the local server (operator and above): a pending server
named after the hostname plus the `setu agent install` command.

get.summary: List sites (viewer and above).

post.summary: Create a site and enqueue its provision job (operator and above).
post.description:
Validates the domain (unique → 409), the app version (must exist and
parse; `image` manifests are rejected with `validation` — phase 2),
the plan (must allow the app) and the server (explicit, or the
online server with the most free memory). Resolves env with the
operator-supplied `prompts`, seals secrets, stores the row as
`provisioning`, then enqueues `provision_site` carrying the prompts
(the runner re-resolves with them).

get.summary: One site (viewer and above).

delete.summary:
Delete the site (operator and above): 202 with a `delete_site` job.
The row disappears when the job finishes; until then `GET` still
finds it (`deleting`). 409 while another job is live.

get.summary: A site's backups, newest first (viewer and above).

post.summary:
Take a manual backup (operator and above): 202 with a `backup_site`
job; the row lands `completed` when the job finishes. 409 while
another job is live for the site.

Restore a backup (operator and above): 202 with a `restore_site` job
carrying `payload.backup_id`. The backup must belong to the site.

get.summary:
Masked env list (viewer and above): names plus `secret`/`once`
flags and `has_value`; secret values render as [`MASKED_VALUE`],
never plaintext.

put.summary:
Update non-generated env vars (operator and above): only manifest
entries spelled `value` or `prompt` may change (`generate`/`from`
are derived and rejected with `validation`). Writes the sealed copy,
issues a synchronous `WriteEnv` to the agent, then enqueues
`restart_site` so the new values take effect.

get.summary:
Live logs as SSE (viewer and above): `FetchLogs` every 2 s, unseen
lines since the cursor render as `data: <line>` events. The stream
ends when the client disconnects (a failed send breaks the loop) or
when the agent call fails (an `error` event first).

post.summary: Restart: stop then start via the runner (operator and above).

Retry a `failed` site: back to `provisioning` with a fresh
`provision_site` job carrying the original prompts (operator+).
Start the unit (operator and above).
Stop the unit (operator and above).

Update to another published version (operator and above): 202 with an
`update_site` job. 409 while any job is live for the site or the site
is not `running` (the runner would refuse it anyway).

get.summary: Liveness: always 200, no auth, no database.
Readiness: 200 when `SELECT 1` succeeds, 503 otherwise.

CommandEnvelope.description:
A command in flight: stable `id` so redelivery is idempotent.
`attempts` counts deliveries (`next_for` bumps it; `requeue_stale`
only resets `delivered_at`), so the agent can tell a retry apart.

CommandResult.description: The agent's report for one command id.

install_command.description: One-line installer using the single binary.

join_token.description: Single-use join token (valid 1 hour); shown once.

value.description: Plaintext for non-secret vars, [`MASKED_VALUE`] for secrets.

EnvVar.description: One concrete env var to write into the site env file.

JobOut.description:
One job row. `payload` is never rendered (it may carry prompt
answers); poll `log` for progress.

JobResponse.description:
A bare 202 job body (delete: the site row is gone when the job
finishes, so no site is returned).

JoinRequest.description: First contact: the agent redeems a single-use join token.

JoinResponse.description: Control-plane answer to a join: the long-lived server identity.

Limits.description:
Resource limits for one site (mirrors the manifest `limits.default`;
kept local so the agent needs no manifest dependency).

name.description: Explicit server name; defaults to the machine's hostname.

install_command.description: One-line installer reusing the already installed `setu` binary.

join_token.description: Single-use join token (valid 1 hour); shown once.

toml.description: Pasted manifest TOML. Exactly one of `toml` / `url` is required.

url.description: URL to fetch the manifest from (public hosts only).

status.description:
Effective status: `pending` until first join, then `online` while
`last_seen_at` is within 60 s, else `offline` (computed at read
time, spec §3/Task 8).

needed.description: True while no operator exists (the wizard must run).

public_url.description: The configured `SETU_PUBLIC_URL`, shown by the wizard.

SiteOut.description: One site row (the sealed `env` is never included; see `./env`).

SiteSpec.description: Everything the agent needs to materialise one site.

UnitState.description: One systemd unit's state as observed by the agent.
